lines.text: Plate seven. The honeybee: Apis mellifera.
lines.asr: Plate seven the honeybee a piece mellafura

lines.text: Each eye is built from some six thousand facets, and every one of them is a lens.
lines.asr: Each eye is built from some 6000 facets and every one of them is a lens

lines.text: In flight, a row of tiny hooks locks the two wings into one.
And on the hind leg, a basket, for carrying pollen home.
A lifetime of such work makes a twelfth of a teaspoon of honey.
